Note: I included one test per hybrid FR because it is NOT specified anywhere in Task 5 the amount of tests required.

tests.scenario: Preferred narrator is automatically set when opening a meditation session
steps: Select a preferred narrator in settings of audio selection
Open a meditation session
tests.expected_result: The session must automatically start playing with the selected narrator's voice.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to be directly testable and tied to the narrator preference feature.

tests.scenario: User is notified a week before previously accessed content is pay walled
steps: Set a previously accessed content item of a user to be pay walled
Check the user's in-app notifications a week prior to the change
tests.expected_result: The system must send an in-app notification that explicitly states what content being pay walled and when the change will happen.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to focus on content that is actively being consumed abruptly being pay walled.

tests.scenario: Sleep session audio plays without interruption for a minimum of 8 continuous hours
steps: Start a sleep session
Leave the session running for 8 consecutive hours
Check whether audio is still playing without crashes or unexpected pauses
tests.expected_result: The application must still be playing audio without interruption from crashes or unexpected pauses after 8 hours.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to include a proper testable threshold for playback consistency.

tests.scenario: Sleep audio library has at least 10 distinct narrator voices and 10 environmental sounds
steps: Navigate to the sleep audio section
Count the number of distinct narrators and environmental sound options available
tests.expected_result: The system must display sleep stories from at least 10 distinct narrators and at least 10 distinct environmental sounds.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to include specific countable thresholds for narrator and sound variety selection.

tests.scenario: Meditation content search returns accurate results within 2 seconds of user input
steps: Enter a search term in the meditation search bar and submit the form
Record the time between submission and the time it takes for the results to appear
tests.expected_result: The system must display accurate results within 2 seconds of the user submitting their input.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to include a specific and testable search performance.

tests.scenario: Narrator's voice is clearly audible over background audio during a meditation session
steps: Start a meditation session with background sounds enabled
Assess whether the narrator voice is clearly audible throughout the session
tests.expected_result: The narrator voice must be clearly audible and must not be drowned out by background audio at any point.
tests.notes: Revised the automated test to focus on background and narrator voice balancing.

tests.scenario: Free tier user can access at least 5 guided meditations and 3 sleep stories without subscribing
steps: Create a new account without subscribing, selecting the free trial option
Navigate to the meditation and sleep sections and attempt to open content
tests.expected_result: The system must grant access to at least 5 guided meditation sessions and 3 sleep stories without prompting a subscription upgrade.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to include specific minimum content counts for the free tier model.

tests.scenario: Free trial sign-up page clearly displays all plan details before the user confirms
steps: Navigate to the free trial sign-up page
Proceed to the payment confirmation step and check for trial details
tests.expected_result: The system must clearly display the trial duration, subscription price post free trial, and exact billing date before the user confirms.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to focus on the explicitness of subscription details and conditions before sign-up.

tests.scenario: No charge is applied after a user cancels a free trial or subscription
steps: Sign up for a free trial and cancel before it expires
Monitor the user's payment method after cancellation is confirmed
tests.expected_result: The system must not proceed with any further charges to the user's payment method after cancellation is confirmed.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to include a concrete cancellation flow and a billing check.

tests.scenario: Refund request for an unwanted subscription charge is processed within 3 business days
steps: Submit a refund request for an unwanted subscription charge
Wait 3 business days and check email for a refund outcome notification
tests.expected_result: The system must have processed the refund and notified the user of the result via email within 3 business days.
tests.notes: Refined the automated test to focus on timely refunds with a measurable deadline.
